topic: §1.5 new <h3> subsection: published ρ_A = 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³ as neutron-star-density walking medium (EXP-623)
our_argument_summary: The new <h3> subsection in §1.5 cites the dome model.html line 638 verbatim quote of ρ_A = 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³, converts it to (a) 3.4×10¹⁴ × water density, (b) 340 Mt per cubic centimeter, (c) ~1.5× nuclear saturation density / typical neutron-star core. Acknowledges as kernel of truth that dimensional back-solving for a medium density from McGaugh g† (SPARC RAR) is the kind of move a working theorist would make, but argues that publishing the result without auditing what it implies for ordinary motion through the medium is the error. Closes with a cross-reference to §1.7 (gravity paradox: model has no machinery to compute how the medium interacts with matter).

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: Dome model.html Tesla principles table row 3 lists the formula RAR: ρ_A = g₀ × ρ_bar / g†. Core-parameters block at line 638 of model.html lists ρ_A = 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³ as derived from this RAR constraint. ρ_bar is not defined on the model page.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: The published number is presented as derived from the formula above. Back-solving for ρ_bar yields ~4.16×10⁶ kg/m³ — denser than any known cosmological or galactic density (cosmic mean ~9.5×10⁻²⁷, Earth core 1.3×10⁴, white dwarf interior ~10⁹). So ρ_bar must have a non-standard meaning that the model page never specifies — the derivation is in practice unauditable from the dome source.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: Tesla principle #3 packages the derivation with the equivalence principle in a row marked CONSISTENT (not CONFIRMED). The CONSISTENT badge is the only published acknowledgement that this row is weaker than the others.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: None. The EXP correctly quotes the verbatim line and links the right URL.

holes_found.description: Kernel-of-truth paragraph overstates the legitimacy of the dome’s specific RAR move. The paragraph says "back-solving a density from an acceleration via dimensional combination is the kind of move a working theorist would make." But the dome’s formula ρ_A = g₀ × ρ_bar / g† uses three inputs, not just an acceleration scale, and the rearrangement has no MOND-theoretical or any-theoretical motivation: MOND treats g† as the transition acceleration scale for galactic dynamics; it does NOT derive an aether density from g†. A working theorist combining quantities with the right dimensions also explains WHY that combination is theoretically motivated. The dome doesn’t. The kernel-of-truth is currently too generous — it credits the dome with doing what a theorist would do, when the dome is actually doing dimensional juggling without theoretical motivation.
holes_found.recommendation: Tighten the kernel-of-truth paragraph to: "g† is a real empirical regularity in SPARC galaxy rotation curves — a measured value, not a fitted parameter. Combining g† dimensionally with a density and an acceleration to back-solve a third density is dimensionally consistent. The error is upstream of that step: MOND treats g† as a transition scale for galactic dynamics; there is no MOND-theoretical or any-theoretical justification for deriving a medium density from it. The dome does not provide one. The published number is the output of a dimensional rearrangement that happens to have the right units, not the output of a derivation in the usual physics sense."

holes_found.description: Nuclear saturation density value imprecise. The subsection writes "1.5× nuclear saturation density (~2.3×10¹⁷ kg/m³)". The standard value of nuclear saturation density, computed from n₀ = 0.16 fm⁻³ × m_nucleon = 1.673×10⁻²⁷ kg, is approximately 2.68×10¹⁷ kg/m³ (not 2.3×10¹⁷). With the corrected value the ratio is 3.4/2.68 ≈ 1.27× saturation, not 1.5×. Still inside the neutron-star-density band (NS core densities span ~ρ_nuc to ~5–10 ρ_nuc), so the "neutron-star density" label survives. But a knowledgeable defender could catch the off-by-15% saturation number.
holes_found.recommendation: Change "about 1.5× nuclear saturation density (~2.3×10¹⁷ kg/m³)" to "about 1.3× nuclear saturation density (~2.7×10¹⁷ kg/m³)". Optional: reference the source of nuclear saturation density (n₀ ≈ 0.16 fm⁻³ standard nuclear physics value) inline or in a footnote.

holes_found.description: Phrase "within a factor of unity" is informal and ambiguous for the lay-reader audience the subsection targets. "Factor of unity" in scientific shorthand usually means "ratio close to 1" — i.e., the two quantities are within a factor of ~1.0 of each other. But neutron-star core densities span (3–6)×10¹⁷ to ~10¹⁸ kg/m³, so 3.4×10¹⁷ is at the LOW end of that band, not within a factor of unity of typical. A non-physicist reader will not know what the phrase means; a physicist reader will note the imprecision.
holes_found.recommendation: Replace "within a factor of unity of the typical neutron-star core" with "of the same order as typical neutron-star core densities (~3–10 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³)" or simply "at the low end of the neutron-star core density band."

holes_found.description: Cross-reference to §1.7 phrased as "the same gap that §1.7 documents for gravity." §1.7 The Gravity Paradox documents that the dome has no gravity DERIVATION (it borrows the Somigliana WGS84 formula wholesale and applies it to flat-disc coordinates). The new §1.5 subsection’s gap is that the dome has no MEDIUM-MATTER INTERACTION derivation (it publishes ρ_A but has no machinery to compute what the medium does to a ball). These are parallel gaps but not the literal same gap. A close reader could flag the imprecision.
holes_found.recommendation: Soften to "the same shape of gap that §1.7 documents for gravity" or "symmetric to the gravity gap §1.7 documents." Minor — preserves the rhetorical pairing without claiming literal identity.

holes_found.description: "vaporizes it instantly" is conservative to the point of understatement. Power deposition into the airframe at v=10 m/s, A=100 m² through a 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³ medium is ~1.7×10²² W — about 1/22,000th of total solar luminosity, delivered into one small plane, every second. That is not vaporization; that is plasma at temperatures unreachable except in stellar interiors. The current framing is technically true but undersells the absurdity. Not a hole in the argument — a missed opportunity to make the bust even more visceral. Leave alone if rhetorical restraint is preferred; sharpen if maximum impact is preferred.
holes_found.recommendation: Optional: replace "vaporizes it instantly" with "dumps roughly 10²² W into the airframe per square meter of frontal area — comparable to stellar-interior energy densities, not anything an aircraft can survive." If sticking with the lay-reader register, the current text is fine.

stronger_arguments.description: Audit the derivation. The dome publishes ρ_A = g₀ × ρ_bar / g† but never defines ρ_bar on the model page. Back-solving for ρ_bar that yields 3.4×10¹⁷ at g₀=9.81 and g†=1.2×10⁻¹⁰ gives ρ_bar ≈ 4.16×10⁶ kg/m³ — denser than Earth’s core (1.3×10⁴ kg/m³), thinner than white-dwarf interior (~10⁹), and matching no standard cosmological or galactic mean density (cosmic mean ~9.5×10⁻²⁷). This is a separate kill from the medium-interaction kill: the published value is the output of an unauditable derivation whose middle term has no defined physical meaning. Could be added as a one-paragraph footnote or as a second subsection. Not necessary for the current argument but available as escalation.

stronger_arguments.description: Equivalence-principle dressing. The dome wraps the RAR derivation with the equivalence principle in Tesla principle #3 ("Energy from environment, not mass; Equivalence Principle from aetheric pressure; RAR: ρ_A = g₀ × ρ_bar / g†"). The equivalence principle is about gravitational/inertial mass equality — it has nothing to do with aether density derivations. The dome is name-checking equivalence principle to make the row look more theoretically loaded than it is. Worth a one-sentence note for completeness, but could be saved for §1.6/§1.7 critiques.

The dome’s CONSISTENT badge on Tesla principle #3 is itself a tell. Rows 1, 2, 4, 5 all carry CONFIRMED badges. Row 3 — the one containing the ρ_A derivation — carries CONSISTENT, the weakest badge in the table. The dome’s own labelling pre-flags that this derivation is not validated, only "not inconsistent". We could cite this as an admission against interest.

kernel_of_truth.description: The EXP’s kernel-of-truth section correctly identifies that g† is a real empirical regularity (model.html line 629 Tesla principle 3 row: "RAR: ρ_A = g₀ × ρ_bar / g†"), that SPARC galaxy rotation-curve fits give g† ≈ 1.2×10⁻¹⁰ m/s², and that combining a small number of physical quantities with the right dimensions IS one of the moves a working theorist makes (EXP-623.json:insertion_html paragraph 2). What it gets right beyond this: it explicitly cross-references §1.7 to acknowledge that the structural problem is upstream of the derivation — the dome has no theory of medium-matter interaction (EXP-623.json:insertion_html paragraph 3, cross-ref to part1 §1.7 verified at sections.json:part1.html:64171). The framing — engage the actual claim, then show that even granting the dimensional move, the resulting number is incompatible with ordinary motion — is correct and matches the review’s house style.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Acknowledging real input data (g†, SPARC) and dimensional consistency (g₀×ρ_bar/g† has units of kg/m³) does not validate the published 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³ number. The kill turns on a separate observation: any medium at that density that is also asserted to push aircraft (Job 2 slipstream, dome live-power page line 529) and to bend distances (Job 3 metric warping, dome line 142) must mechanically interact with ordinary matter — and the dome publishes the number without ever computing what that interaction would do (cross-reference to part1 §1.7 verified — sections.json:part1.html:64171, which documents that the dome borrows the Somigliana WGS84 formula and has no field equation connecting aether to acceleration). The kernel-of-truth saves the dome from a strawman charge; it does not save the published number from a Sydney-Perth airframe (own arithmetic this review: 1.7×10²² W power deposition at v=10 m/s, A=100 m²).

deeper_analysis: EXP-623 lands a real kill on a real published number. The dome’s model.html publishes ρ_A = 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³ alongside λ_g, κ, and λ_A in a "Core parameters (all physically derived, none free)" block. The number is nuclear-density material — 14 orders of magnitude denser than water — and the dome’s SAME page asserts (line 529 live-power.html) that the medium pushes aircraft as a slipstream and (line 142) that it contracts ground distance metrically. The combination is incoherent: a 3.4×10¹⁷ kg/m³ medium that mechanically interacts with aircraft would deposit ~10²² W into a plane at modest velocities, which is several orders of magnitude beyond stellar-interior energy densities. The dome publishes the number without computing this implication. The argument is structurally clean and the EXP makes it well. The four minor holes I found are precision issues, not framing breaks: (1) nuclear saturation density inaccuracy (2.3 → 2.7), (2) "factor of unity" phrasing for a lay audience, (3) "same gap" vs "same shape of gap" for §1.7 cross-ref, (4) optional rhetorical sharpening on "vaporizes". The one moderate hole (kernel-of-truth overstates what a working theorist would do) is worth fixing because it leaves the strongest single objection a defender could raise — "you conceded our derivation is legit physics, now you’re back-pedaling on the implication" — partially unanswered. Tightening the kernel-of-truth to "dimensional consistency yes, theoretical motivation no" closes that flank. Net: integrate with the moderate fix; the minor fixes are operator’s call. No verdict change. Decider may patch in-place via narrow string edits.
summary_for_decider: EXP-623 is sound and lands a real kill. Recommend MINOR_EDIT — keep the subsection as integrated. One moderate hole worth a narrow patch: tighten the kernel-of-truth paragraph to acknowledge dimensional consistency but not theoretical motivation of the dome’s specific RAR rearrangement (proposed text in holes_found[0].recommendation). Four minor holes for optional polishing: nuclear saturation density 2.3→2.7 with ratio 1.5→1.3 (holes_found[1]); "factor of unity" phrasing (holes_found[2]); §1.7 cross-ref imprecision (holes_found[3]); optional rhetorical sharpening on "vaporizes" (holes_found[4]). Three stronger arguments available as escalation (audit-the-derivation, equivalence-principle dressing, CONSISTENT-badge admission) — none required for this subsection; can be saved for adjacent §1.6/§1.7 work. The HNOTE remains pending — Commissions 1 (dome statics) and 3 (one-sentence indictment) are still deferred per the EXP’s remaining_hnote_commissions block.
